lens: LENS 2 -- the 14:21 late long, and whether filter 5 makes us structurally late
headline: The 14:21 long was NOT a filter-5 bull reclaim. Filter 5 never cleared on 2026-08-06 (175/175 ticks blocked, safe AND bold). The trade was a bollinger_squeeze extra-setup on a lane that does not consult filter 5 at all. Pricing every filter-5-blocked bull entry on real OPRA through the production exit core: 13/13 entries, -$471.00 total, mean -$36.23 -- earlier entry does NOT dominate. Filter 5 SAVED money today.

verdict_detail.was_1421_late_or_just_a_loser: NEITHER 'structurally late' NOR simply unlucky -- it was a correct-by-config entry that bought within 1 cent of the intraday top of the move and was stopped in 4 minutes by its own validated -8% cell. Real OPRA: C769 peaked at 1.22 high / 1.08 close around 14:25 and bled to 0.28 by 15:55. SPY 769.55 -> 768.53. The whole afternoon after 14:25 was a fade.
verdict_detail.does_filter_5_make_us_late: NOT ON THIS TAPE. Filter 5 blocked 175/175 ticks and every single one of the 13 sole-blocker release points would have LOST money through the production exit engine (-$471 total). Filter 5 was NET POSITIVE today. The structural-lateness hypothesis is NOT supported by 2026-08-06.
verdict_detail.n_disclosure: n=1 session, 13 counterfactual entries on ONE contract on ONE afternoon. This is NOT evidence of a general property in either direction. It is sufficient to REFUTE the specific claim made about this specific trade, and nothing more.
verdict_detail.generalisation_gate: The brief's condition was 'if and only if earlier entry dominates, generalize to the 25-day book and 391-day population.' Earlier entry does NOT dominate -- it is strictly worse (-$471 vs -$36). The generalisation is therefore NOT RUN. It also does not need to be: the 391-day population question was already answered on 2026-07-28 (DO_NOT_ARM, -$46, 1/5 gates).

why_this_is_not_the_graveyarded_item.distinction: Filter-5 DELETION removes the gate unconditionally for every bull candidate. A structure-shift ALTERNATIVE is an OR-branch: filter 5 still blocks unless a specific micro-structure predicate (higher low above the reclaimed level + high exceeding the reclaim bar's high, within K=3 bars) is satisfied -- a strictly smaller admitted set. They are genuinely different levers.
why_this_is_not_the_graveyarded_item.but: The distinction is now MOOT on evidence, not on logic. The OR-branch version was A/B'd as its own hypothesis (prereg #2, 2026-07-28) against the full 391-day population and returned DO_NOT_ARM at 1/5 gates. And on the bull side specifically it is a PROVEN NO-OP for entries. So the alternative lever joins the graveyard on its own measurement -- it is not being rejected by association with filter-5 deletion.
why_this_is_not_the_graveyarded_item.recommendation: Move structure_shift_confirmation from 'dormant capability awaiting quantification' to 'MEASURED AND KILLED (2026-07-28, 1/5 gates)'. It should stop appearing in briefs as untapped upside.

prereg_candidates.problem: A core-decisions row's top-level `verdict` describes the PRIMARY-setup path ONLY. The extra_exec lane can place a REAL broker order on the SAME row while that row's verdict reads HOLD (today: 14:21:03 verdict=HOLD bull_blockers=[5,11], while extra_exec PLACED a real 3-lot C769). Anyone reading verdicts -- human or script -- concludes the engine was idle. This session's own brief drew exactly the wrong root cause from it, attributing the trade to filter 5.
